servers.name: personal
servers.guidance: Indexed mail and Drive first: mindos_search before any filesystem tool when the user names attachments, people, or email threads. mindos_calendar_* for schedule; mindos_summarize_url for URL/PDF content and compare-two-files; mindos_gmail_sync → mindos_process_outbox only when search is empty or user wants fresh Gmail.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.guidance: Local disk only—not Gmail/Drive ingested mail. For attachments, recipients, or mail thread names use personal mindos_search first. mindos_fs_locate for on-disk paths under allowed roots; mindos_fs_find only for explicit globs. No root=/. Destructive: preview then confirmed=True.

servers.name: convert
servers.guidance: Local conversion; source unchanged. mindos_fs_locate or mindos_convert_file (paths from user words). Batch: mindos_convert_batch previews then confirmed=True.

servers.name: fetch
servers.guidance: Backend for mindos_summarize_url (PDF/HTML pagination). Do not call fetch_* directly for user summarize requests—use mindos_summarize_url instead. search_web only for open-web queries without a URL.
